indicators.name: mortality_rate_external_causes
indicators.title: Mortality from external causes
indicators.description: Mortality rate due to external causes (per 100,000 population)

indicators.name: dengue_cases_notified
indicators.title: Dengue cases
indicators.description: Shows the number of dengue cases notified each week. The values are retrospectively updated every week to reflect the most accurate data available.

indicators.name: dengue_incidence_rate
indicators.title: Dengue incidence
indicators.description: Is a representation of the estimated incidence rate of dengue, calculated as the number of reported cases per population, multiplied by 100.00. It provides a standardized measure to compare dengue occurrence relative to the size of the population.

indicators.name: dengue_alert_level
indicators.title: Dengue alert level
indicators.description: Is a classification that indicates the current risk of dengue outbreaks in a given region. This level ranges from 1 to 4, as follows: 1 (Green): Low risk - situation under control. 2 (Yellow): Moderate risk - caution advised. 3 (Orange): High risk - alert for potential outbreak. 4 (Red): Very high risk - critical situation with epidemic potential.

indicators.name: dengue_confirmed_cases
indicators.title: Dengue confirmed cases
indicators.description: Is a number of dengue cases that have been definitively confirmed through laboratory testing. It reflects only those cases for which diagnostic tests have validated the presence of the dengue virus, ensuring accuracy in reporting and surveillance.
